description: This source file defines a custom exception class `InvalidParamException` within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for API v2 error handling related to invalid parameters. The class includes methods to manage an error bag array and provides a normalized representation of invalid parameter keys.

classes.name: InvalidParamException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing an invalid parameter error in the OrangeHRM API v2, including an error bag for detailed error information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the InvalidParamException with an optional error 'errorBag', message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getErrorBag
methods.description: Returns the current error bag array containing error details.

methods.name: setErrorBag
methods.description: Sets or updates the error bag array with new error details.

methods.name: getNormalizedErrorBag
methods.description: Provides a normalized array including the keys of the invalid parameters.
